validity.researcher_notes: The recorded $383,000,000 matches EIA's workbook exactly (single source, medium tier -- see the SegmentCost fill). However, the operator's own current site (goldenpasspipeline.com) describes the compression-station expansion (MP33 + MP69) alone as a '$500+ Million TOTAL INVESTMENT' -- a materially larger and more recent figure. The FERC December 21, 2016 order (167 FERC-series, Docket Nos. CP14-517/CP14-518), which I read directly via a third-party-hosted copy, footnotes a $383 million figure to the original 2014 application's Exhibit K, which is consistent with the recorded value being the ORIGINAL cost estimate rather than the current actual cost -- but I could not cite that order here because the only copy I located fails scripts/url_verifier.py with a persistent SSLError (both the default and insecure-retry TLS attempts fail, despite curl fetching it fine at HTTP 200; a Wayback Machine lookup to substitute a citable snapshot hit a 429 rate limit and could not be resolved in the time available). Recommend a follow-up check against the certificate's own cost table or a current sponsor cost disclosure before treating $383M as still current.
